text:
Erin: Planning note  Sapphire Health case + launch post + webinar mention. Interview Wednesday 2pm ET. Need: approved press quote, one 20s webinar clip, launch post draft, and a benchmark sidebar comparing baseline vs Redwood. Can legal do quote review same-day?
Samir: I'll record and produce a short draft post. Will drop raw audio + a quick benchmark table (CSV) to Drive.
AssetBot: Placeholder created: https://drive.redwood/sapphire/session_4207.mp4
Nadia (prod): FYI the benchmark should call out per-token cost and a p95 latency diff. Use neutral phrasing unless customer approves numbers.
Claudia (legal): Any numeric claims require written signoff from the customer. If they give numbers live, get an email confirmation or a signed release. Public copy default = non-numeric (e.g., "meaningful per-token cost reductions").
Vik (sales): For lead routing I'm going to route webinar interest to HubSpot campaign "Sapphire Webinar". Need a 1-line quote for the slide by 10am so SDRs can prep.
Erin: Raw quote from Sapphire (verbatim): "Redwood cut our inference spend by 42% and reduced p95 latency by 60ms." Posting for legal.
Claudia (legal): Please redact numbers to "meaningful" unless we get explicit written permission. I'll email Sapphire counsel right now for permission to publish exact figures.
Samir: I'll capture both versions during the call (numeric + cleaned). Also will include a short benchmark snippet that Sales can see internally (numbers locked).
Nadia (prod): Note wording preference for public post: use "continuous batching" and "KV cache" exactly when describing technical cause. Avoid saying "quantization" unless Sapphire approves the technical detail.
Vik (sales): If numbers are redacted, slide copy we'll use: "Sapphire saw meaningful per-token cost reductions and faster latency with Redwood." OK?
Claudia (legal): That's fine. If Sapphire's counsel okays numbers, we need an email thread attached to the case file.
Erin: Timeline: Wed 2pm interview -> Samir upload assets + draft post by 6pm -> Claudia to approve quote or request redaction by EOD -> Vik builds HubSpot form + workflow by EOD.
AssetBot: Reminder scheduled: legal follow-up in 4 hours.
Samir: Will post upload links here when ready. Ping if blocked. :rocket:
